svg.aria-label: Two ways to learn how long a run took. Asking the agent: a table that summed to about 18 minutes for a run of 6.2 minutes. Reading the log: seconds measured by the verb itself.

g.text: Same 6.2 minute run, two sources of time
about 18 min: timestamps typed by hand, thinking time guessed
Bar lengths are drawn to scale: 18 min against 6.2 min.
